title: poterium sanguisorba subsp. glaucescens
intro: Poterium sanguisorba subsp. glaucescens, commonly known as the Red Goosefoot or Red Sorrel, is a perennial plant belonging to the Amaranthaceae family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Poterium sanguisorba subsp. glaucescens include reducing inflammation, treating wounds, and alleviating digestive issues. Its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and ascorbic acid, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
